scenes.title: Sela at pier four
scenes.summary:
Sela Thorn offers a daylight boat trip and says she will return at first light tomorrow.
She says Saltmere Mine flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago, with warm water according to her grandmother.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary:
The party finds warm black water and hymn-book pages; one page bears the pencilled name "M. Brand", which Teo identifies as Mira's handwriting.
Vessa and Oren suspect harbor-master Maren is involved with the choir, but their theory remains unconfirmed.

scenes.title: A warning on the shore
scenes.summary:
The party returns at dusk and visits the shore below the chapel despite Sela's warning.
An unnamed fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother pulls children into the water; the GM presents this as the fishermen's claim.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary:
At midnight the underwater bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale shapes appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing.
The GM marks the choir clock at three of six, and the party leaves.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary:
The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light tomorrow and dive to the chapel at low tide during daylight.
Bram says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay; the party stays at the inn.
